forum.title: ST-LINK upgrade issue
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Mohammadali,

The product you are using is a clone of a genuine ST product.

To get the support you need, please contact the third party you purchased this product from.

For assurance of buying authentic ST products, we recommend purchasing exclusively through our official distributors, which you can find listed here: [ST Official Distributors](https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/contact-us.html).

Best regards,

Maxime
forum.content_text: Hi, I got a black pill. It says everywhere that to enter DFU mode, you have to keep pressing BOOT0, then press and release RST, then release BOOT0. But every time I do this, Cube IDE says ST-Link is not in the DFU mode, please restart it.
forum.author: Mohammadali

scraped_replies.html:
Black Pill is not an ST product, and possibly might not contain a genuine STM32.

You need to contact the supplier or manufacturer for support.

Also, what ST-Link are you using?

 

to enter DFU mode, you have to keep pressing BOOT0, then press and release RST, then release BOOT0. But every time I do this, Cube IDE says ST-Link is not in the DFU mode

For DFU mode you don’t use an ST-Link - the programmer talks direct to the target.

 

Are you trying to upgrade your ST-Link, or just program your board?
